source.metric: sum of the last 5 hourly buckets (= meta.total_tweet_count over the window)

ranking_rule: rank_score = 5h count, except that a burst hour (an hour > 6 x max(29h hourly median, 3) whose next hour fell below a third of it) is capped at that limit; only differs from mentions for burst-flagged entries; ties by mentions

group_sweep.query_pattern: ($T1 OR $T2 OR ...) -is:retweet -whatsapp -telegram -tg -"stock analyst" -"hot stocks" -"discussion group" -"investment advisor" -"join for free" -"exclusive group" -"Ms. Victoria" -"follow him" -"dm me" -"dm for" -"private channel" -"copy trade" -challenge -signals -mexc -"my go to" -vote -leaderboard -coinmarketcap -"listing id" -airdrop -memecoin -memecoins -solana -pumpswap -dexscreener -gmgn -"pump.fun" -mcap -marketcap -mc -ca -"my call" -cabal -token -crypto -bnb
group_sweep.note: A group count is an exact count of posts mentioning ANY ticker of the group (a post with several of them counts once), with the spam filter applied. It is an upper bound for every member, so a quiet group means all its tickers are quiet.

risers_rule: rank_score >= 20 and max(momentum_5h_vs_prev_day, momentum_last_hour_vs_prev_9h) >= 3.0, where the last-hour ratio only counts if the last hour is also >= 2x the same hour yesterday; momentum = (now+1)/(baseline+1)

spam_handling.filter: every X query (group sweep, every individual count, every sample) carries the spam suffix
spam_handling.post_rules: sampled posts are dropped for discovery if the author is in config/spam_accounts.txt, the text is a template (same text from >= 3 authors), a ticker dump (> 8 cashtags, or >= 4 cashtags with < 8 real words), or contains a filter term
spam_handling.clean_gate: a discovered or carryover ticker is only ranked if a sample of this run (or a passed check <= 24h old) shows clean posts from >= 3 distinct authors and, with >= 5 sampled posts, a clean share >= 30%; others are listed in held_back with their count
spam_handling.sample_clean_share: sample_clean_share = clean / all sampled posts mentioning the ticker (relevancy samples, small n); informational, the rank stays the exact filtered count; core entries below 30% get the label low-clean-share

note: Ranks the tickers counted individually in this run (core + carryover + tickers discovered via the group sweep and samples), all over the same UTC window. The whole non-core stock universe is screened at group level every run, but a ticker is only ranked if it was counted individually; discovery is sampled, so a busy ticker can still be missed.
